summary_en: This phase 1/2 study tests DS3790a, an antibody-drug conjugate (DXd-ADC) that targets CD37, in adults with hematological malignancies, including B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma. The drug is given as specified in the protocol, alone or with a combination regimen whose drugs are not named, and the dose schedule and duration are not stated. The main outcome measure is not stated; the study is designed to assess safety, preliminary efficacy, and pharmacokinetics.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1/2 evalúa DS3790a, un conjugado anticuerpo-fármaco (DXd-ADC) que apunta a CD37, en adultos con neoplasias hematológicas, incluido el linfoma no Hodgkin de células B. El fármaco se administra según lo especificado en el protocolo, solo o con un régimen de combinación cuyos medicamentos no se nombran, y la frecuencia y la duración de las dosis no se indican. El resultado principal no se indica; el estudio está diseñado para evaluar la seguridad, la eficacia preliminar y la farmacocinética.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older who sign the consent form
Histologically documented hematologic malignancy per WHO 5th edition classification
LVEF of at least 50% within 28 days before the trial starts
Life expectancy of at least 3 months
not_for: Brain or leptomeningeal disease, unless treated with no progression within 4 weeks
Current or past non-infectious lung inflammation (ILD/pneumonitis) needing steroids, or suspected and not ruled out
Another malignancy diagnosed within the previous 3 years
